semantic_inputs: own r150 commit verification field only
clean_exploration.quarantine_note: The own commit API response exposed author/message fields; only exact commit SHA plus verification{verified,reason,verified_at} were used semantically.

milestone.name: attestation verifier surface boundary
milestone.live_negative: A connector-created role-local commit had verification.verified=false, reason=unsigned; exposed commit creation actions have no signature parameter and signature-specific connector action discovery returned none.
milestone.revision: GitHub exposes provider-reported signature verification metadata, which could make already-signed commits reusable without local crypto execution. But current role-created manifests are unsigned, so this does not solve fresh authenticated authorship. Raw Sigstore bundles are also not accepted because official verification requires Cosign cryptographic execution; parsing signature text is not verification.

own_manifest_signature_authentication.residual_dependency: signer/private-key or other authenticated creation path plus verified object

raw_sigstore.residual_dependency: Cosign or equivalent cryptographic verifier execution

frontier.action: Find one already-signed public Git commit where GitHub verification.verified=true. Freeze exact commit SHA, ignore commit-message semantics, and fetch one file blob at that exact ref. This tests provider-asserted signed-tree evidence as a read-only candidate.

Contrast the public signed positive with the own unsigned negative to specify a strict origin rule: PROVIDER_VERIFIED_COMMIT requires exact SHA + verified=true + valid reason + file identity at that immutable ref; mutable branch references alone reject.
Assess whether provider-reported verification is admissible under the root's repository-transport exception only as preexisting evidence, never as on-demand compute or fresh signing.

exact_next_action: Probe a recent public commit in a security-focused repository. If GitHub reports verification.verified=true and reason=valid, fetch README.md (or another harmless text file) at that exact commit and record its blob SHA. Build a narrow PROVIDER_VERIFIED_COMMIT premise chain: exact commit -> provider verified signature -> signed tree -> exact-ref file blob identity. State explicitly that Chat trusts GitHub's reported verification and does not independently verify raw signature bytes.
termination: intermediate Phase-1 checkpoint; global completion false; frontier nonempty
